initial_sql:
SELECT
    c.id AS customer_id,
    c.name,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.status != 'void' THEN i.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS billed,
    COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) AS paid
FROM
    customers c
LEFT JOIN
    invoices i ON c.id = i.customer_id
LEFT JOIN
    payments p ON c.id = p.customer_id
GROUP BY
    c.id, c.name
ORDER BY
    c.id

SELECT
    e.id,
    e.title,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'confirmed' THEN r.seats ELSE 0 END), 0) AS seats,
    COALESCE(COUNT(t.id), 0) AS tags
FROM
    events e
LEFT JOIN
    registrations r ON e.id = r.event_id
LEFT JOIN
    tags t ON e.id = t.event_id
GROUP BY
    e.id, e.title
ORDER BY
    e.id
final_sql:
SELECT
        e.id,
        e.title,
        COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.seats) FROM registrations r WHERE r.event_id = e.id AND r.status = 'confirmed'), 0) AS seats,
        COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tags t WHERE t.event_id = e.id), 0) AS tags
    FROM
        events e
    ORDER BY
        e.id

initial_sql:
SELECT
    e.id,
    e.title,
    COALESCE(r.seats, 0) AS seats,
    COALESCE(t.tags, 0) AS tags
FROM events e
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT event_id, SUM(seats) AS seats
    FROM registrations
    WHERE status = 'confirmed'
    GROUP BY event_id
) r ON e.id = r.event_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT event_id, COUNT(*) AS tags
    FROM tags
    GROUP BY event_id
) t ON e.id = t.event_id
ORDER BY e.id
